name: Oc len
summary: Ốc len is a mangrove snail. Dân Việt names it on the town menu. Thanh Niên names ốc len xào dừa as a box at Hàng Dương, 700 g, and names ốc among the three things visitors ask for, with ghẹ and tôm tích. A coconut ratio was not printed.
origin: Can Gio. Dân Việt, 2 Oct 2022. Thanh Niên, 11 Mar 2019, at chợ hải sản Hàng Dương.
howToEat: Order it with the seafood lunch. Thanh Niên’s named plate is ốc len xào dừa. Dân Việt does not print a cook.
Dân Việt prints 440,000 VND a kilogram on 2 Oct 2022, including the cooking. Thanh Niên prints 100,000 VND for a 700 g box of ốc len xào dừa on 11 Mar 2019. A 2026 price is Check on arrival.
where: Hàng Dương on đường Thạnh Thới, or the town streets. The hour is Check on arrival.
